sources.entry: Marmot - Data catalog for discovering and organizing data assets across your stack, including databases, APIs, message queues, and pipelines. (Demo, Source Code) MIT Docker

summary.one_liner: Marmot is an open-source data catalog, shipped as a single binary, for discovering and organizing data assets such as tables, topics, queues, APIs and dashboards.
summary.what_it_does: Marmot lets teams catalog data assets (tables, topics, queues, APIs, dashboards) and enrich them with metadata, ownership and business context. It offers full-text search plus structured queries, boolean logic and metadata filters. Its interactive lineage view traces data flows from source to destination and supports impact analysis before changes. Teams can maintain shared glossaries and assign owners to assets. Certified context is exposed to AI agents through MCP (Model Context Protocol), the API and the UI. Data sources are added through a plugin system, and the README invites contributors to build new plugins.
use_cases: find data tables and topics across a stack
trace data lineage and assess change impact
document data ownership and business context
give AI agents access to metadata via MCP
self-hosted data discovery for small teams
how_to_run: Follow the Deploy guide in the Marmot documentation (marmotdata.io/docs)
Or download the single binary for your platform and run it
notable: Ships as a single binary with a built-in UI, with no heavy infrastructure required
Exposes cataloged metadata to AI agents through MCP, the API and the UI
Interactive lineage tracing from source to destination with impact analysis
Plugin system for adding new data source types
caveats: The README does not describe platform requirements or limits beyond the single binary and Docker listing
Data source plugins are needed for catalog coverage beyond the listed asset types
